name: @pipeworx/mcp-brawl-stars

tools.name: player
tools.description: Brawl Stars official API — full profile for a player tag (#9LJ2YR9…): trophies, highest trophies, club, brawler count, 3v3 wins, solo/duo wins, and experience level.

tools.name: player_battles
tools.description: Brawl Stars official API — recent battle log for a player tag: battle time, event/map, mode, result, star player, teams, and brawlers used per battle.

tools.name: club
tools.description: Brawl Stars official API — full club profile for a club tag: name, description, type, trophies required, total trophies, and member count.

tools.name: club_members
tools.description: Brawl Stars official API — paginated member list for a club tag: each member's name, tag, trophies, role, and name color. Supports limit/after/before cursors.

tools.name: brawlers
tools.description: Brawl Stars official API — complete list of all brawlers with their numeric ID, name, star powers, and gadgets.

tools.name: brawler
tools.description: Brawl Stars official API — detail for a single brawler by numeric ID: name, star powers with descriptions, and gadgets with descriptions.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-brawl-stars forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the brawl-stars pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
